writing:or:119.hint: ある技術が人々に新しい行動を可能にすることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:119.question: Smartphones enable us [[for]] stay connected with friends anytime.
writing:or:119.fullSentence: Smartphones enable us to stay connected with friends anytime.

writing:or:120.hint: 理由の一部が主な原因であることを示す表現は何か。
writing:or:120.fullSentence: The company succeeded mainly because of its strong marketing.

writing:or:121.hint: あるものが別のものより多くの利点を持つことを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:121.question: Electronic dictionaries have several advantages [[on]] paper ones.
writing:or:121.fullSentence: Electronic dictionaries have several advantages over paper ones.
writing:or:121.explanation: ~より利点があるという構文。

writing:or:122.hint: 利点が欠点よりも大きいことを主張する構文は何か。
writing:or:122.question: The advantages of remote work outweigh the [[disadvantage]].
writing:or:122.fullSentence: The advantages of remote work outweigh the disadvantages.
writing:or:122.explanation: 利点が欠点を上回るという構文。

writing:or:123.hint: その問題について賛否が大きく分かれていることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:123.fullSentence: It is a highly controversial issue whether or not the death penalty should be abolished.
writing:or:123.explanation: 賛否が分かれる論争的な問題を示す構文。

writing:or:124.hint: ある行動をとる人が年々増えていることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:124.fullSentence: There is a growing tendency toward working from home among young employees.
writing:or:124.explanation: ~する傾向が高まっている、という構文。

writing:or:125.hint: 政府が強い対応策を取らなければならないと述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:125.question: The government has to take drastic measures [[for]] reduce carbon emissions.
writing:or:125.fullSentence: The government has to take drastic measures to reduce carbon emissions.
writing:or:125.explanation: 思い切った対策をとる、という構文。

writing:or:126.hint: 将来において重要な役割を果たすだろうと予測する構文は何か。
writing:or:126.question: Artificial intelligence will play a vital role [[on]] our lives in the future.
writing:or:126.fullSentence: Artificial intelligence will play a vital role in our lives in the future.
writing:or:126.explanation: 重要な役割を果たすという構文。

writing:or:127.hint: ある問題が深刻な危険をもたらすことを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:127.fullSentence: Climate change poses a serious threat to coastal cities.
writing:or:127.explanation: 深刻な脅威をもたらす、という構文。

writing:or:128.hint: 何かが人々の生活に大きな打撃を与えることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:128.question: The disaster had a devastating impact [[in]] the local economy.
writing:or:128.fullSentence: The disaster had a devastating impact on the local economy.
writing:or:128.explanation: 大きな影響を与えるという構文。

writing:or:129.hint: 経済を活発にする助けとなることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:129.fullSentence: Tourism can help boost the national economy.
writing:or:129.explanation: 経済を活性化させる、という構文。

writing:or:130.hint: 人々に問題の重要性を認識させる必要があると述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:130.question: We must raise public awareness [[on]] food waste.
writing:or:130.fullSentence: We must raise public awareness about food waste.
writing:or:130.explanation: 意識を高める必要がある、という構文。

writing:or:131.hint: 個人的な意見をまず述べてから、その理由を続ける構文は何か。
writing:or:131.fullSentence: In my opinion, students should be allowed to choose their own subjects.
writing:or:131.explanation: 自分の意見を導入する構文。

writing:or:132.hint: 述べてきた理由を簡潔にまとめる表現は何か。
writing:or:132.question: [[For]] sum up, online learning offers both benefits and challenges.
writing:or:132.fullSentence: To sum up, online learning offers both benefits and challenges.

writing:or:133.hint: これまでに述べた理由を踏まえて結論を導く表現は何か。
writing:or:133.question: According [[for]] the reasons stated above, I support this policy.
writing:or:133.fullSentence: According to the reasons stated above, I support this policy.
writing:or:133.explanation: 上記の理由により、という表現。

writing:or:134.hint: ある制度が学力の低下を引き起こしたと主張する構文は何か。
writing:or:134.fullSentence: Relaxed education has led to the decline in academic ability of children.
writing:or:134.explanation: ~の低下を引き起こした、という構文。

writing:or:135.hint: 大学の評判が良いほど就職の可能性が高まると述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:135.question: If a college is more prestigious, its graduates are more likely [[for]] get good jobs.
writing:or:135.fullSentence: If a college is more prestigious, its graduates are more likely to get good jobs.
writing:or:135.explanation: ~する可能性が高い、という構文。

writing:or:136.hint: ある政策に効果があるという科学的な根拠がないと主張する構文は何か。
writing:or:136.question: There [[are]] no scientific evidence that capital punishment is a deterrent to crime.
writing:or:136.fullSentence: There is no scientific evidence that capital punishment is a deterrent to crime.
writing:or:136.explanation: 科学的な証拠はない、という構文。

writing:or:137.hint: あるものが生活に欠かせないほど重要だと述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:137.fullSentence: Clean water is indispensable for human health.

writing:or:138.hint: ある事態が起こると予測されることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:138.question: It [[are]] expected that renewable energy use will increase sharply.
writing:or:138.fullSentence: It is expected that renewable energy use will increase sharply.

writing:or:139.hint: ある考えに同意する意思を明確に述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:139.question: I agree [[by]] the idea that students should wear school uniforms.
writing:or:139.fullSentence: I agree with the idea that students should wear school uniforms.
writing:or:139.explanation: ~という考えに同意する、という構文。

writing:or:140.hint: 自分の意見を支える理由が2つあることを予告する構文は何か。
writing:or:140.fullSentence: I have two reasons to support my opinion.
writing:or:140.explanation: 意見を支持する理由を予告する構文。

writing:or:141.hint: 実際には別の見方をする人もいると述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:141.fullSentence: Actually, some people argue that social media does more harm than good.
writing:or:141.explanation: ~と主張する人もいる、という構文。

writing:or:142.hint: ある事実について本当にそうだと確認する構文は何か。
writing:or:142.question: It [[are]] true that fast food is convenient but unhealthy.
writing:or:142.fullSentence: It is true that fast food is convenient but unhealthy.
writing:or:142.explanation: ~というのは本当だ、という構文。

writing:or:143.hint: 何かが依然として主な原因の一つであると述べる構文は何か。
writing:or:143.question: Traffic accidents are still one [[for]] the leading causes of death among teenagers.
writing:or:143.fullSentence: Traffic accidents are still one of the leading causes of death among teenagers.
writing:or:143.explanation: 依然として主要な原因の一つだ、という構文。
